title: [SOLVED] Printing test page fails
body: I am trying to make use of the printer (Canon TS5150) on my system. Using AUR I installed a vendor driver and using KDE settings added a printer. Everything seemed to work and I tried to print a test page. However nothing happened and queue was reporting pdftopdf exiting with status 1.
